basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast exploring my way through gadgets and fitness supplements. Recently moved to Stouffville and enjoying the vibrant maker community here. I spend my evenings tinkering with electronics and catching up on General Sam's latest gaming antics. Currently working as a junior software developer and always eager to learn more about health and technology. In a relationship, and we both love experimenting with new tech. My typical online hours are in the evening after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science from self-study and some online courses. My interest in health supplements like creatine is more recent and stems from personal research and community discussions. I learn a lot from reading threads and watching YouTube videos.
